# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you find a security issue in one of my repositories, please do not open a public issue with exploit details.

Instead, report it privately using GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature if enabled, or contact me through the appropriate GitHub profile contact method.

## Scope

Security issues may include:

- Exposed secrets
- Unsafe defaults
- Vulnerable dependencies
- Command injection
- Authentication or authorization problems
- Dangerous documentation examples
- Misconfigured CI/CD workflows

## Out of scope

The following are generally out of scope:

- Issues in intentionally insecure lab code
- Obvious non-production experiments
- Cosmetic README problems
- Theoretical issues without a realistic impact path

## Expectations

Please include:

- Repository name
- Affected file or component
- Description of the issue
- Steps to reproduce, where safe
- Suggested fix, if known

I will review reports when able and prioritise issues based on impact.
